back and leg muscles that allow me to run much,

The stinging, irritant coating on its colorful necklace acts as a seducer.
The core of nectar it contains is bugbait
The kind that anyone gets crazy over

like a disease of the mind,
it controlls you.
Puppets you around
Makes you do their bidding.
I put my heart and soul on the table
Just for a bit more of their touch
just for one more of their kisses
Just for one more validation from them
and from them alone.
Im a slave of their will
And their eyes.
I cant stop.

Just thinking about their eyes at night keeps me awake under the sheets.
So scared of giving in.
What I feel is nothing short of violent.
Just the possibility of fully giving in to their power
fills each and every single fiber of my body with shivering,
terrifying dread.
Their stem sucks at my submission.
My pleas.
"Please stop.
Please. Im already yours.
Please.
Please!
...
Its enough"

It keeps them fed
It keeps the black hole.

Ready for more of my whimpers.
For more of my shaky breathing.
I am out of common sense.
Their beatings feel like being watered on the inside.
My eyes stay watery
And my sobs,
My sniffs spread the seeds to other parts of my mind.
As she gets ready to further consume me.
To swallow me whole.
